info.title: Safar · Bus Booking Management System API
info.description: All endpoints are under `/api/v1`. Errors always look like `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details?", "requestId" } }`. Money is in integer paise. Times are ISO-8601 UTC; the business timezone is Asia/Kolkata.

post.summary: Hold seats for a segment (10 min by default)
post.description:
Requires login (any role). Passengers see only their own data.

Replaces any previous hold by the same user on this trip. 409 SEAT_UNAVAILABLE if a seat is booked or held by someone else for an overlapping segment.

post.summary: Confirm a booking from a hold → PNR
post.description:
Requires login (any role). Passengers see only their own data.

Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. Retrying with the same key and body returns the original 201 response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different body returns 422.
